instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. `yarn vitest run packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx`: 2 failed | 8 passed. Change ONLY these two tests; keep the other 8 exactly as they are. (1) 'undo restores the previous size' (line 118): AssertionError: expected 'small' to be undefined. Cause: the arrow is put in the scene with `API.setElements([arrow])`, which assigns h.elements directly and never records it in the store, so undo has no baseline. Verified: with `const arrow = UI.createElement("arrow", { x: 10, width: 100 })` (a drawn arrow, which is recorded and selected), clicking `arrowheadSize-small` pushes one undo entry and `Keyboard.undo()` leaves `arrowheadSize` undefined. Create the arrow with UI.createElement (import UI from "./helpers/ui" alongside Keyboard) and read it by `arrow.id`; remove the duplicated last `expect(...).toBe("small")`. (2) 'restore keeps valid sizes and drops others' (line 178): TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'arrowheadSize'). Cause: the line `expect(sizeOf.call(null, "") ?? null).toBe(null);` looks up an element with id "" in h.elements; delete that line. Every import must stay used (eslint --max-warnings=0). Answer with exactly one JSON object {path, edits: [{search, replace}]} or {path, content}.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
